title: Heat Pump Tax Credit 2026: The 25C Credit Has Expired — Here's What Still Works — Energy Rebate Calculator Blog
summary: 2026 guide: the federal 25C heat pump credit expired at end of 2025; HEAR rebates (income-limited, uneven rollout) and state programs remain.

assertions.quote: Heat pumps installed in 2026 or later do not qualify.
Section 25C tax credit Up to $2,000 (30% of cost) Expired Dec 31, 2025
income-qualified households (under 150% of Area Median Income) can receive up to $8,000 for a qualifying heat pump
The catch is availability. HEAR rollout has been uneven:
provides $5,000 to $12,000 for air-source heat pumps in residential properties of 1–4 units.
R-410A will become increasingly expensive and difficult to source as the phasedown advances, affecting future repair costs.

verdicts.note: The AIM Act phasedown has raised R-410A prices, but reclaimed supply will keep existing units serviceable for years.
